parsed.name: Go2四足机器人
parsed.description: Go2四足机器人是一种小型腿式移动机器人，具有机动行走与远程通信能力，常用于机器人运动控制、感知导航、巡检和人机交互等实验研究。
parsed.description_en: The Go2 quadruped robot is a compact legged mobile robot with agile locomotion and remote communication capabilities. It is commonly used in laboratory research on robot locomotion, perception, navigation, inspection, and human-robot interaction.
